purpose: Prospective four-level linear-static TET10 torsion campaign. This is a prepared contract only; it is not an execution authorization receipt and contains no mechanical result.
owner_authorization: The user explicitly authorized bounded static FEM in the J24 request.

execution_gate.reason: The applicable DEVELOPMENT_AUTONOMOUS procedure requires an exact registered worktree ID and exact nodeid for monitored FEM. The read-only policy in the original user checkout lists D01/C01/E01 and static_pilot_01 scopes, but has no J24 scope; static_pilot_01 execution is disabled in its launcher. The current main checkout has no dedicated J24 test nodeid, and the existing structural convergence campaign runs a broader TET4/TET10, traction/bending/torsion suite.
missing_procedure_fields: A dedicated exact J24 test nodeid
A registered J24 worktree identity, baseline ancestry, source inventory and solver source root
A per-node attempt ledger and budgets accepted by the applicable runner

inputs.model: L=3 m, R=0.5 m, E=80 GPa, nu=0.30, density=2700 kg/m^3, T=1000 N.m, x=0 fully fixed, four quadratic TET10 meshes

measurements.rotation: Least-squares rigid rotation fit over all nodes of x=L: sum(y*u_z-z*u_y)/sum(y^2+z^2); compare with TL/(GJ).
measurements.stress: Use stored TET10 integration-point stresses and coordinates; compare tau_xy=-T*z/J and tau_xz=T*y/J pointwise with physical-volume weights. Do not use recovered nodal maxima as direct values.
measurements.equilibrium: Archive force and moment reactions at x=0; force residual normalized by T/R and moment residual by T.
measurements.free_residual: Use the solver's documented relative free-DOF residual and preserve raw norm and denominator.

prospective_indicators.load_torque_relative_error: <= 1e-12 (already met by the mesh/load preflight; recheck at the model passed to the solver)
prospective_indicators.free_relative_residual: <= 1e-8 (existing bounded structural campaign value; not a general solver qualification)
prospective_indicators.integration_point_stress_error: descriptive only until a separate tolerance justification; no stress PASS criterion in this contract

resources_proposed_not_measured.retry_rule: Stop after any failure; a retry requires a classified source/instrumentation/launcher change or a new diagnostic hypothesis and new attempt ID.

expected_artifacts_if_unblocked: Per-level model inputs and exact mesh/setup/load hashes
Per-level displacement vectors, residuals, reactions, energies and solver route status
Per-element integration-point stress coordinates and values
Per-phase timing/RSS/output-size observations, stdout/stderr and attempt ledger
CSV summary and figures clearly marked as FEM result or analytic reference
execution: NOT_RUN; no FEM solve was attempted under this contract.
